results.title: ‘Lord of the Rings’ Officially Confirms 2026 Release Is Less Than 3 Weeks Away
results.content:
The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power Season 3 premieres November 11 on Prime Video, putting its return less than three weeks away. The eight-episode season begins with four episodes releasing together, giving viewers half the season on premiere day. Two more episodes follow November 18, with the final pair scheduled for November 25. That schedule means the entire season will be available before Thanksgiving in the United States. It also makes this a considerably more concentrated release, [...] release, with the story unfolding across three Wednesdays. Anyone planning to follow along as episodes arrive should set aside more than a single hour for the November 11 premiere. [...] Daniel Weyman’s Gandalf also enters this chapter having finally discovered his name. Meanwhile, the Elves’ resistance continues after the destruction of Eregion, with Lindon and Rivendell among the strongholds standing against Sauron. The coming episodes bring those stories closer to the creation of the object that will eventually draw all of Middle-earth into another war.

The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power Season 3 premieres November 11 on Prime Video.
